name: Rakshasa
description: Demons who with the naga allow humans to rule the Sultai.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the rakshasa Ebirri offers Taigam power in the Sultai, and Taigam pledges his life to the rakshasa.
timeline.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.

timeline.summary: Sidisi explains she has raised an army by levying five percent of each province, then demanding the eldest born, with Rakshasa enforcing compliance.
timeline.quote: she had requested that all of the Sultai provinces provide five percent of their population to be enlisted into Sidisi's army.

timeline.summary: Khudal and Shidiqi abandon Tasigur with the prophecy 'And so the Sultai fall'; the naga and rakshasa leave the Sultai.
timeline.quote: And so the Sultai fall," the naga echoed, and she was gone, too.

relations.note: Rakshasa emissaries enforce her army levy.
relations.quote: Rakshasa emissaries sent to the provinces who were not compliant quickly quelled any risk of an uprising.

pages_say.description: Powerful demons whose age-old deals are the source of much Sultai power and undead.
Sultai emissaries who wield magic and enforce Sidisi's army levy in noncompliant provinces.
Demons with whom Sultai rulers made pacts to secure their elite status.
Demons who with the naga allow humans to rule the Sultai.
